plugin.name: environment
plugin._long: A plugin to set environment variables on startup.

group._long: Specifies environment variables to set on startup.

option.name: environment
option._long: Sets environment variables with `setenv()` on startup. The ID is the name of the variable, so it must be different for distinct variables. The value can only be a simple string. Use this to set Wayfire-specific environment variables instead of setting them for all DEs and WMs.
